_readme: First own-site map read at Ventura College (S346, SkyCairn). Its mapper (programmap.venturacollege.edu) answered 403 on 2026-10-04 (probe run 37198225537). A domain search (2026-10-08) found the Automotive Technology baccalaureate's page, which describes a prescribed schedule of courses for its two-year cohort. This read loads that page and prints any term-by-term schedule or schedule PDF it links.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses.
